description: This file contains a Java class 'InventoryServices' that provides various static methods for handling inventory-related operations within the OFBiz framework. These include preparing, completing, and canceling inventory transfers, checking inventory availability, and retrieving product inventory summaries. The methods interact with entities like InventoryItem, InventoryTransfer, and related views, perform validation and calculations, and invoke other services to manage inventory data and notify relevant parties.

classes.name: InventoryServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing inventory operations such as transfer, availability checks, and inventory summaries within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: prepareInventoryTransfer
methods.description: Prepares an inventory transfer by validating the inventory item, splitting quantities if needed, updating inventory details, and setting transfer statuses.

methods.name: completeInventoryTransfer
methods.description: Completes an inventory transfer by updating inventory quantities, setting the transfer status to complete, and adjusting inventory item states accordingly.

methods.name: cancelInventoryTransfer
methods.description: Cancels an inventory transfer, restoring inventory quantities and statuses, and setting the transfer record to cancelled.

methods.name: checkInventoryAvailability
methods.description: Checks inventory levels for back-ordered items, updating reservations and sending notifications or cancellations based on availability and shipment schedules.

methods.name: getProductInventoryAvailableFromAssocProducts
methods.description: Calculates product inventory availability by considering associated products and their respective inventory, returning ATP and QOH totals.

methods.name: getProductInventorySummaryForItems
methods.description: Provides a summary of inventory and pricing information for a list of order items across facilities, including ATP, QOH, and related prices.

methods.name: getProductInventoryAndFacilitySummary
methods.description: Retrieves inventory and usage summaries for a specific product at a facility, including stock levels, prices, and sales/production usage.
